name: com.tozmart.tozmartsdk_s6.ProfileActivity
description: After the Tozmart OneMeasure S6 camera supplies front and side photos, this screen processes them into a body profile and shows progress, image guidance, and the result. From here the user can review measurements or correct the outline.
disableEffect: The S6 flow cannot process the captured photos into a body profile or continue to its measurement results.
